- [RCTS.1.2.14] **The standard library is always there.** Every compiler finds its bundled library on every
  invocation ([LIMP.3.3.1]), so a harness must resolve every fixture's
  imports against the standard library the repository under test ships under
  `stdlib/`, after `libraries` ([RCTS.1.2.13]), and `units.core` is preloaded
  for every fixture as for every program ([LUNI.4.1.2]). It must read those
  modules where they ship, never from a copy, and must fail its run, not the
  fixture, when it cannot read them.

  A library name that both `libraries` and the standard library supply makes
  the fixture malformed, and a harness must fail it rather than choose
  between them. A fixture that carries a `stdlib` member, whatever its value,
  is malformed too ([RCTS.1.2.15]).
